scale_cues: Plate is roughly 26-28 cm across and used as the primary scale reference; steak slices estimated from their thickness relative to plate width. Florets sized against the plate rim.
assumptions: Steak is beef, cooked medium-rare, edible portion after trimming, with no visible bone or large fat cap.
Cauliflower weight is cooked, drained, edible weight.
Potato weight is cooked, flesh and skin, after roasting.
Chicken and the top-left pale item are assumed to be cooked poultry and savory stuffing; identities are uncertain.
Oil or butter weight is a small residual estimate, not a measured amount.
Garnish herbs and garlic bits are under 5 g and merged into the steak item.
